description: This class includes the processing of new or spent (recycled) plastics materials into intermediate or final products, using such processes as compression moulding; extrusion moulding; injection moulding; blow moulding; casting.
includes: manufacture of semi-manufactures of plastics products
manufacture of finished plastics products: plastic plates, sheets, blocks, film, foil, strip
manufacture of plastics tubes, pipes, hoses and fittings
manufacture of plastics packaging goods: bags, bottles, boxes, cases, crates, containers
manufacture of plastics floor, wall and ceiling coverings
manufacture of plastics tableware, kitchenware and other household articles
manufacture of plastics furniture and parts
manufacture of plastics builders' ware: doors, windows, frames, shutters, blinds
manufacture of plastics garments and clothing accessories
manufacture of artificial guts (sausage casings) from plastics materials
excludes: manufacture of plastics in primary forms, see 2013
manufacture of synthetic rubber in primary forms, see 2013
manufacture of articles of foam rubber, see 2219
manufacture of sport goods of plastics, see 3230
manufacture of games and toys of plastics, see 3240
